data.title: Unit 10: Force and machines
Force
data.heading: Freezing
data.text: Mass is the amount of matter that is contained in an object. It is measured in kilograms.
Weight is the amount of gravitational force acting on an object. It is measured in newtons and is denoted by N.
The mass and the weight of an object remain the same on Earth.
In outer space, there is no force of gravity, so the object will have no weight at all.
The mass of the object will remain the same in space as it has the same amount of matter.
